description: Sets the state of an existing case file (title, subtitle, case sheet), subfolder (name), saved reference (subfolder, set aside with a reason) or AI note (text, pinned, set aside). Only the fields given change; giving the same values again changes nothing. Overwrites the previous values. Notes written by the user cannot be changed. Nothing is deleted: deletion is delete_account_item. Requires a JusticeLibre account (OAuth sign-in); without one, the tool says so.

assistant.description: note: assistant name stored with the new text.

case_file_id.description: note, with pinned false: case file it goes back to (default: most recent holding the text).

deadlines.description: case_file: replaces the list; dates copied from the user.

family.description: case_file: jud, adm, ce, eu or "".

kind.description: case_file (permission fiche), subfolder (ranger), item = saved reference (subfolder: ranger; set_aside: ecarter), note = AI note (text, pinned: notes_ia; set_aside: ecarter).

parties.description: case_file: replaces the list; aliases only, never real names.

pinned.description: note: true = follows its text into every case file holding it; false = back to one case file.

reason.description: item, note: reason, with set_aside true; omit to reuse the earlier one.

set_aside.description: item, note: true = set aside (kept, not proposed again); false = restored.

name: update_account_item
